APPENDIX
Training details: To account for differences in demonstra-
tion length between datasets, we adjust the rollout horizon
for Layman v2 while keeping all other settings fixed. Specif-
ically, we use 1200 timesteps for  thecantask and 1400
timesteps for thesquaretask on Layman v2, compared to
500  and  800  timesteps,  respectively,  for  Robomimic-MH.
This adjustment reflects the longer and more variable trajec-
tories in Layman v2, which arise from increased trial–error
behavior by non-expert users. In all cases, timestep limits are
chosen based on the maximum trajectory lengths observed
in each dataset to ensure fair and consistent evaluation.
